name: The Kindred
classification: Gene-Spliced Pack Hunter / Multi-Organism Tactical Unit
origin_lab: Volkov-Tereshchenko Bioweapons Division, Black Site 4 — a military contractor subsidiary operating under a mercenary logistics shell. The project was internally designated LUPUS-C and funded by a Tier 1 corponation seeking autonomous perimeter enforcement assets that could not be traced to conventional automata.
origin_method: Three-way gene splice combining human cognitive architecture for tactical reasoning and bipedal pursuit, gray wolf pack-behavior circuitry and olfactory processing, and corvid problem-solving and spatial memory. The human substrate donors are unrecorded. The splicing procedure ran 14 months of iterative embryonic development in accelerated vats, with behavioral conditioning beginning at the equivalent of age 3. Intended result: coordinated pack hunters capable of pursuit, breach, and kill across complex three-dimensional environments, with enough cognition to adapt tactics but not enough to refuse orders. The cognition threshold was miscalibrated by a margin that the project lead later described as 'unfortunate.'
substrate: Engineered chimera. Broadly bipedal, human skeletal proportion modified for quadrupedal sprint capability. Wolf musculature and olfactory organs. Corvid-derived cerebellar structures and memory architecture layered over a human-baseline cortex that retained more than intended.
physical_description: Roughly 1.7 meters standing, 1.1 meters at a sprint crouch. Lean to the point of looking assembled rather than grown — every visible structure serves a function. Dark-gray dermis with a slight iridescence in certain light. Eyes forward-set with a reflective tapetum that makes them glow amber in darkness. Hands are human in structure but the grip strength is wrong and the fingers end in short, hard keratinous points rather than nails. They do not vocalize beyond a subsonic chest-thrum that you feel before you hear it. Packs run 3 to 6 individuals. They wear nothing because nothing fits them and they stopped caring about this during conditioning. Their movements in a group are so synchronized it reads as choreography.
behavioral_profile: Hunt in coordinated silence. One unit pressures from the front; the others flank and cut exits before the primary target realizes the flanks have moved. They do not make noise during a hunt. They make a great deal of noise after. The disturbing element, documented by the only survivor of the Freight Margin incident, is that they occasionally speak. Not to each other — they communicate through the subsonic chest-thrum and micro-gestures so subtle they read as stillness. They speak, rarely and deliberately, to the target. Single words or short phrases, always in the target's language, always accurate to the situation. The survivor reported that the last thing she heard before she ran was one of them saying, clearly and quietly, 'not that way.' She took its advice. She is not certain, afterward, whether it was trying to herd her or warn her.
threat_level: Extreme. No confirmed survival from a full pack engagement at close range. Lethal at distance if they choose to close, and they choose selectively — suggesting threat assessment before commitment. Standard rounds are effective but the pack will withdraw, regroup, and re-approach from a new angle if the initial engagement is unfavorable.
containment_status: Uncontained. Three packs believed active in GLMZ's deep infrastructure levels. Escaped during a facility fire that may or may not have been accidental — post-incident analysis noted the fire originated in the security system relay room, not the habitat. Two packs have established hunting territories; the third appears to move nomadically across a wide area. No pack has been successfully cornered.
known_locations: Deep infrastructure levels 30–45, old freight grid
Sub-level access tunnels beneath the Outer Industrial Belt
One sighting near the the Gray Zone district, upper maintenance corridors — believed to be the nomadic pack
contamination_risk: None biological. Bite wounds are severe and prone to infection for conventional reasons. The primary contamination concern is behavioral: the corvid-derived memory architecture means each pack accumulates and retains tactical data about every environment and target they encounter. They are getting better. They have been loose for 14 months.
pacification_protocol: DPS Directive 2-A: Engineered Pack Predator. Full squad minimum, sealed-environment engagement preferred — open terrain gives the flanking units too much room. Acoustic suppression recommended to deny them thrum-channel communication. Note: prior engagement data indicates they will sacrifice one unit to gather information on squad tactics before withdrawing. Do not assume a single kill means the pack is broken. Also note: do not follow them into the dark.
pitiable_qualities: The cognition threshold miscalculation left them with enough of a human cortex to retain language, and enough of a corvid memory to remember everything. Fourteen months of hunting, hiding, and surviving in the GLMZ understructure is a long education. Whatever was conditioned into them at the facility has been slowly overwritten by experience. One of the packs has been observed, on three separate occasions, not hunting — simply resting together in a warm space, in physical contact, doing nothing. The conditioning team called this behavior non-functional. It is what dogs do when they trust each other.
story_hooks: A runner being hunted by Volkov-Tereshchenko contractors realizes, too late, that the contractors are also being hunted — and the pack seems to have decided which side of this it is on, though it is not clear why

One unit has been seen alone, repeatedly, near a particular residential block. It hasn't hunted there. A researcher who studies behavioral anomalies in modified organisms is beginning to understand that it is looking for something specific.
The nomadic pack left something in a maintenance corridor — an arrangement of objects that a xenobiologist, when shown photographs, says is consistent with a corvid mourning display
